bootstrap_scope: 20,000 fixed-seed draws; resample 3 instance pairs within each fixed world; two repeats averaged; descriptive, not population-wide

design.paired_on: world, panels, episode observation-index noise, claim confirmation keys, scientific action budgets, order
design.decoding_difference: GPT medium/max_completion_tokens/8000 vs DeepSeek high/max_tokens/32000; native effort and output/time budgets differ
design.empty_output_policy: empty visible replies consume one invalid-action turn, matching nonstream chat; no reasoning fallback or retry
design.interpretation: same scientific tasks and scoring, different output and time budgets; descriptive system comparison, not an equal-budget model ranking

budget_change.interpretation: same scientific tasks and scoring, different output and time budgets; descriptive system comparison, not an equal-budget model ranking
